data.name: Ruthia
data.long_meaning: Ruthia is a Hebrew name meaning "Friend of God". In the Bible, the Book of Ruth tells the story of Ruth, a Moabitess who converted to Judaism and became the great-grandmother of King David. Ruth demonstrated faithfulness, courage, and loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi and to her God.

The name is also a reminder of the importance of interfaith relationships and the ability for people of diverse backgrounds to connect and form bonds.
